def.item: C0 (P2_1/n ion pair, gas: pre-optimisation, optimisation, proton check, finite-difference frequencies, FMO/cubes/molden)
def.cost: gas: 6-31G(d) pre-optimisation 15-60 steps x 1.8 min (cap 3 h) + 5-40 evaluations x 7.3 min (cap 100 / 12 h) + FD Hessian 198 gradients x 7.3 min (measured 21 Nov) in 33 chunks + fmo ~1 h
def.note: resumable: an interruption loses at most one 3-column chunk (6 gradients, ~0.7 h) or one optimisation step; FD worker peak RSS 6.4 GB at MAX_MEMORY_MB 5500 (msi has 7.1 GB)

def.item: C0 (P2_1/n ion pair, IEF-PCM water: pre-optimisation, optimisation, proton check, FMO/cubes/molden; frequencies in c0_btpcz_pcm_softmode)
def.cost: IEF-PCM: 6-31G(d) pre-optimisation 15-60 steps x 5.2 min (cap 6 h) + 30-100 evaluations x 17.3 min (cap 100 / 30 h) + fmo ~1.2 h
def.note: resumable (rerun continues); stops early on a stall (gradient criteria met for 10 evaluations with < 1e-6 Ha spread); at a cap it is accepted only on the btpc_pcm rule, otherwise it fails and waits for the user (raise --opt-max-hours to continue)

def.item: 6 (relaxed gas scan of C1-O1...N4-C12, -180 to -60 deg in 15 deg steps, B3LYP)
def.cost: 9 points x 10-25 gas evaluations x 7.3 min (msi)

def.item: 5 (B3LYP-D3(BJ) gas re-optimisation, seeded with the stored gas Hessian, FMO at the minimum)
def.cost: 20-60 gas evaluations x 7.3 min (msi) + final analysis

def.item: 4 (converged IEF-PCM minimum, B3LYP-D3(BJ), seeded with the stored PCM Hessian)
def.cost: 30-100 PCM evaluations x 17.3 min + final analysis 0.7 h; capped at 30 h
def.note: item 4 wants all five criteria, so no stall stop here: at the 30 h cap the job fails (resumable) and the user decides (continue with a larger --max-hours, or accept on forces with --negligible-stop 10)

def.cost: Hirshfeld/CM5 from the stored wavefunctions (1.3 min measured on msi)

def.cost: 1 gas + 6-7 PCM SCFs chained by permittivity
